# Daily Report — 2026-10-28

## Task Completed
Added `sys_db_object` table metadata tools (`list_tables`, `get_table_definition`).
`list_tables` queries the `sys_db_object` table with optional `name_query`, `label_query`,
`scope`, and `is_extendable` filters plus pagination. `get_table_definition` resolves a
table by exact name or 32-character sys_id and returns full metadata including label,
super_class (parent table), scope (application), is_extendable, and the four access flags
(create/read/write/delete). Both tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
